posts.name: Sawyer Merritt
posts.text:
Ark Invest on a potenial Tesla-SpaceX merger:

 "A SpaceX-Tesla merger could take place within the next five years. Tesla’s highly cash-generative robotaxi network could help fund SpaceX’s ambitious plans for orbital data centers, and at the same time SpaceX’s compute-intensive
posts.why: Widely shared quote from ARK's new Tesla note putting a possible SpaceX-Tesla merger within the next five years, with robotaxi cash helping fund SpaceX's orbital data centers; a long-horizon view, not a near-term signal.

posts.name: Tasha Keeney
posts.text: 2/ We also updated robotaxi pricing to capture a wider range of willingness to pay, which supports our price target. We model Tesla standalone, but note meaningful synergies from a possible SpaceX merger—SpaceX could contribute almost 2/3 of combined entity revenue in the next 5
posts.why: ARK's new Tesla model is built standalone but flags real synergies from a possible SpaceX merger, saying SpaceX could bring almost two-thirds of combined revenue; a long-horizon view, not a near-term signal.

posts.name: Gary Black
posts.text: Why do $TSLA investors on X keep focusing on a $SPCX - $TSLA merger as a value driver? I’ve argued many times that a stock-for-stock deal where $SPCX buys $TSLA at even a 15-20% premium won’t add much value, given SPCX’s relatively low EV/EBITDA multiple.  And yet $TSLA bulls
posts.why: Gary Black pushes back on the merger as a value driver, arguing a stock-for-stock SpaceX buyout of Tesla even at a 15-20% premium adds little value for Tesla holders.
posts.factor: Analyst view / deal structure and price

posts.name: Tesla
posts.text:
Tesla shareholders: Our Annual Meeting is coming up on Dec 3rd

This year, we’re asking you to vote “FOR” all three proposals on the ballot, including the re-election of Elon Musk, Robyn Denholm and JB Straubel to Tesla’s Board.

Last year, we laid out our vision for building a world of amazing abundance – this year, it’s been coming to life. And we’re only getting started…

Your vote is critical to helping us maintain that momentum.

Voting instructions & control numbers to follow soon.
 
More info: VoteTesla.com
posts.why: Tesla itself kicks off the Dec 3 vote campaign on the three routine proposals, confirming nothing merger-related is on this year's ballot.
posts.factor: Annual meeting / proxy filed (routine, no merger item)

posts.name: Electrek.co
posts.text: Tesla (TSLA) proxy shows a board getting ready for a SpaceX merger https://electrek.co/2026/10/19/tesla-tsla-proxy-annual-meeting-spacex-merger/ by @fredlambert
posts.why: Electrek reads the proxy as merger groundwork: director Ira Ehrenpreis now sits on SpaceX's board, Musk's pay vests fast on a change in control, and the auto-vote program starts at the next meeting, where a deal would land.
posts.factor: Process / governance read of the proxy (analysis, no new facts)

posts.name: Reuters Legal
posts.text: Tesla filed its proxy statement with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday asking shareholders to re-elect CEO Elon Musk, Chair Robyn Denholm and director JB Straubel to three-year terms at its December 3 annual meeting. https://t.co/9Z2P7CNerj
posts.why: Reuters confirms Tesla's definitive proxy (filed 6:15 AM ET) sets the delayed 2026 annual meeting for Dec 3 with only routine items, so there's no merger on this year's ballot.
posts.factor: Annual meeting / proxy filed (routine, no merger item)

posts.name: Robin
posts.text:
Here is the full annual proxy for the December 3, 2026 AGM. (Annual General Meeting)

No Tesla-SpaceX merger-related news in it. Nothing about a special committee or a merger proposal.
They could still delay the AGM or call a special meeting later.
https://t.co/BHCBg08kqx https://t.co/1VCZ4J09Ho
posts.why: A read of the full proxy finds no special committee or merger proposal, leaving only a later special meeting as the path for a deal vote.

posts.name: First Squawk
posts.text: TESLA ANNUAL MEETING OF HOLDERS WILL BE HELD ON DEC. 3
posts.why: First wire headline on the proxy, 11 minutes after it hit EDGAR: the long-delayed meeting date is finally set.

posts.name: Gary Black
posts.text: 3/ I agree with those who say the sole purpose of last night’s Roadster event was to make the case for a $SPCX-$TSLA merger.  My guess:  Announcement in next few weeks $SPCX buys $TSLA for $420/share in SPCX stock; deal could take a year to close.
posts.why: A long-time TSLA bull and fund manager now expects an announcement within weeks, with SpaceX buying Tesla at $420/share in stock, which is below the $450 vote floor in the dashboard's deal math.
posts.factor: Analyst view / deal structure and price

posts.name: Sawyer Merritt
posts.text: SpaceX has announced that they will release their Q3 earnings on October 20th (next Tuesday). Tesla's Q3 earnings will be on October 21st (next Wednesday).
posts.why: Back-to-back SpaceX (Oct 20) and Tesla (Oct 21) Q3 calls give both companies a near-term window to address the combination and the delayed annual meeting.

posts.name: CNBC
posts.text: Prediction market odds on Tesla-SpaceX merger are above 50% for early 2027
posts.why: Major outlet reports prediction-market odds for a merger by early 2027 crossed 50% after the Barclays note and Roadster event.

posts.name: Dan Ives
posts.text:
The impressive Roadster event puts the Tesla/SpaceX relationship on the table
in a tangible way, with propulsion, pressure-vessel, and control hardware developed sitting on a Tesla product, which in our view strengthens the case operating as one engineering platform over time🎯🏆
posts.why: Named sell-side (Ives): Roadster hardware collab strengthens the one-platform / combination case.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.text: Tesla x SpaceX
posts.why: Musk brands the Roadster unveil as Tesla x SpaceX — public combination framing from the CEO at the product event.

posts.name: Ed Ludlow (Bloomberg)
posts.text: Barclays analyst Dan Levy has put a note out saying a Tesla-SpaceX merger announcement is possible before December AGM, which would need to be held no later than Dec 6.
posts.why: Bloomberg's Tesla/SpaceX reporter confirms the Barclays note; sell-side now says pre-AGM announcement is possible.

posts.name: First Squawk
posts.text: BARCLAYS: TESLA-SPACEX MERGER ANNOUNCEMENT POSSIBLE BEFORE DEC
posts.why: Headline that drove the Kalshi/Polymarket near-term spike the evening of Oct 14.

posts.name: Ed Ludlow (Bloomberg)
posts.text: Adam Jonas back on Bloomberg Tech after many years. Included a conversation about Tesla/SpaceX merger and a reality check from Adam on what Optimus really is: marketing
posts.why: Morgan Stanley's Jonas discussing the merger on Bloomberg; Optimus skepticism bears on deal valuation.

posts.name: Sawyer Merritt
posts.text: Elon Musk today when asked why Tesla and SpaceX are still two separate companies: "Great question there. With all this collaboration, on so many levels, who can imagine what action one might take when there's so much close collaboration in so many areas." Merger 😏
posts.why: Musk's on-the-record non-denial at the All-In Summit (Sep 14) — the clearest public hint so far.

posts.name: Bloomberg
posts.text: SpaceX and Tesla investors are wondering the same thing: Is a merger ahead?
posts.why: Bloomberg framing ahead of SpaceX's first earnings call; merger is now mainstream investor question.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.why: Musk flatly denies the WSJ report that Tesla weighed selling its China business to clear a SpaceX merger — denies the China step, not the merger itself.

posts.name: Bloomberg
posts.text: Tesla is weighing a potential separation of its China business to pave the way for a potential merger with SpaceX, the Wall Street Journal reported
posts.why: Only 'people familiar'-style process report to date (WSJ); Musk denied it within the hour.

posts.name: CNBC
posts.text: JPMorgan calls the possibility of a SpaceX-Tesla merger 'strategically coherent'
posts.why: Second major bank endorsing the strategic logic of a combination.

posts.name: The Information
posts.text: Elon Musk could propose a merger of SpaceX and Tesla, as expectations for it grow. SpaceX leaders are already also working for Tesla on the $55 billion Terafab semiconductor manufacturing project, @graceihle reports.
posts.why: Reported staff overlap (Terafab) — operational integration that precedes a combination.

posts.name: Sawyer Merritt
posts.text: SpaceX President Gwynne Shotwell in new interview on a potential merger with @Tesla: "That might make Elon's life a little easier. There's no question that there are synergies between Tesla and SpaceX and our futures definitely there's a convergence of what we're all trying to…"
posts.why: SpaceX's president openly endorses synergies on IPO day rather than dismissing a merger.

posts.name: Walter Bloomberg
posts.text: $TSLA - TESLA-SPACEX MERGER BET GAINS MOMENTUM. Wedbush maintains its view that Tesla and SpaceX could merge in 2027 following SpaceX's IPO, assigning an 80%+ probability to the deal.
posts.why: Wedbush (Ives) puts 80%+ on a merger, but in 2027 — supports the deferred/special-meeting path.
